definitions.explanation: A three-dimensional solid with six equal square faces.

examples.japanese: ⟦サイコロ→サイコロ：06524_saikoro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{立方体|りっぽうたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: A die has the shape of a cube.

notes:
{立方体|りっぽうたい} is a mathematical and geometric term for a cube — a solid with six equal square faces. Encountered in ⟦{算数|さんすう}→算数：04170_sansuu⟧ (elementary math) and ⟦{数学|すうがく}→数学：01442_suugaku⟧ (mathematics).

FORMS:
⟦{立方|りっぽう}→立方：24083_rippou⟧ (cubic) + ⟦{体|たい}→体：09872_tai⟧ (body, solid). The term ⟦{立方|りっぽう}→立方：24083_rippou⟧ itself means "cubic" and appears in units like ⟦{立方|りっぽう}→立方：24083_rippou⟧⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧ (cubic meter).
